text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: change in median-forecast absolute error against the control (fleet shape, pinned capacity). Line: 99% interval, resampling whole weeks. Each panel has its own horizontal scale. Scored year 2025-07 to 2026-06, leads to 168 hours, equal substation weights.'
text.tspan: Dot: change in median-forecast absolute error against the control
(fleet shape, pinned capacity). Line: 99% interval, resampling whole weeks.
Each panel has its own horizontal scale.
Scored year 2025-07 to 2026-06, leads to 168 hours, equal substation weights.
